aka: THE INVENTORY WILL BE DRAWN UP AT 11 A.M IN THE PRESENCE OF THE POET’S WIFE
this_title: L’État des lieux sera dressé à onze heures en présence de la femme du poète
trans_title: THE INVENTORY WILL BE DRAWN UP AT 11 A.M IN THE PRESENCE OF THE POET’S WIFE
introduction: Poet and radio producer Franck Venaille’s study is being emptied. Micha Venaille and Martin Verdet find in it many recording of his voice. The place becomes a stage of all that is never done in a dead man’s room.
chinese_title: L’État des lieux sera dressé à onze heures en présence de la femme du poète
